description: This Java interface defines a provider for SignalEnrichmentFacade objects, which are created based on an HTTP request. It is used within the Gateway endpoints to provide signal enrichment capabilities, likely for websocket or server-sent events streams.

classes.name: GatewaySignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: A Java interface that declares a method for producing SignalEnrichmentFacade instances from HTTP requests, intended to be implemented and loaded via reflection in the system.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Abstract method that, given an HttpRequest, returns an instance of SignalEnrichmentFacade, used for signal enrichment in gateway endpoints.
